Chi è W Divers Coron

I tuoi piani a Coron iniziano con una conversazione.

W Divers Coron si trova a Coron, Palawan. Qui puoi scoprire le possibilità di immersioni sui relitti, sulla barriera e di island hopping, poi contattarci per organizzare il viaggio che desideri.

Our story

From a shipyard in Korea to the wrecks of Coron.

W Divers Coron is a Korean-run dive centre in Coron, one of the best-known wreck-diving areas in the world. It was founded by instructor Dean Kang (강덕환), who spent 20 years at Hyundai Samho Heavy Industries in Korea, where he was also president of the company's scuba diving club.

After leaving the shipyard he chose Coron, Palawan for his second chapter and opened W Divers on the town's main street on 1 March 2015. Starting a business abroad without first spending years in the local Korean community worried the people around him; he credits the good people who helped him settle in.

What's ready when you arrive

Shop
An air-conditioned, glass-fronted dive shop on Coron's main street.
Boats
Two of our own dive bancas, plus a clean, air-conditioned multicab for transfers.
Equipment
Rental equipment bought new. Dive computers, scooters, nitrox and oxygen are available.
Stay
Five air-conditioned rooms of our own, and help booking fan rooms, Korean resorts or hotel-style resorts with pools.
Hours
Open every day, 7:00 am to 9:00 pm.
Languages
Guidance in English and Korean.

Wreck diving, with a stamp to remember it.

Coron's wrecks are a training ground for technical divers learning penetration, yet many also let recreational divers safely look inside. Our guides have long wreck-diving experience, and each wreck has its own stamp for your logbook once you've dived it. Beyond the wrecks there's Barracuda Lake and Cathedral Cave, where warm water rises from hot springs, and reefs for easy fun dives.

On screen

Dugong and shipwreck guide for SBS Law of the Jungle.

From 21 to 23 January 2020, W Divers supported the filming of SBS's Law of the Jungle in Coron. SSI Instructor Trainer Dean Kang worked as the show's dugong guide and shipwreck penetration guide.

Meet our Pro's

Una destinazione da esplorare in più modi.

Alcuni arrivano con un relitto nella lista dei desideri. Altri pensano alla prima immersione o a una giornata in mare con gli amici. Parti dai tuoi interessi, poi chiedi al team quali opzioni ci sono per il tuo soggiorno.
